_about: Helplines the social-casino chrome and responsible-gaming page signpost, keyed by target market (SITE-TYPES 5.2 shape, with the policy-urls verified fields). GambleAware closed on 31 March 2026 and is banned by lint sc.helplines. In Phase 1 the pages still carry these numbers in engine code (engine/lib/layout.mjs, engine/pages/responsible-gaming.mjs); Phase 2 reads them from here. 'verified' stays null until a person has called or opened each entry from a UK connection.
